input.summary: Replace the revocable, term-limited Deliverable licence in 14.2 with a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense Deliverables for Customer's business.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 14.2 gives us only a revocable, non-transferable licence expiring with the Order Form term in work product we paid to have created. We have left Vendor's ownership of Deliverables and its Vendor Technology intact and taken our fallback position instead: a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense Deliverables for our business.

ops.oldText: Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
ops.newText: Customer receives a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify, and sublicense each Deliverable for its business.
